subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text:
stimulus: will you go to madrasah today the mother said to her son mother our classes are suspended then go to market and bring some vegetables. let me be ready and give me some money Part B : Composition (40 Marks)
guide_solution: “Will you go to madrasah, today?” the mother said to her son. “Mother, our classes are suspended.” “Then, go to the market and bring some vegetables.” “Let me be ready and give me some money.”
